_doc: Combat AI knobs for js/ai.js (E42). Every decision a hero or an enemy makes is scored in 'health points': damage it will really deal (after misses, armour and overkill), healing that actually lands (overheal does not count), damage a buff or taunt will prevent, or the output a status takes away from its target. The highest score wins and the unit's reason is written onto the combat event. The rules came from the original game's AI (research/ai-rules.md); the numbers below are the knobs. js/ai.js keeps an identical copy as a fallback and tests/ai.test.js checks the two match.

roles._doc: Who counts as a tank or a healer when deciding whom to protect. Healers also use the looser heal threshold and keep mana back for an emergency heal. Any unit currently taunting also counts as a tank.

heal._doc: threshold: a healer tops up anyone under this share of health. emergency: anyone with a heal uses it below this. never: nobody is healed at or above this share. selfThreshold: a self-only heal (Second Wind) waits until the caster is under this. A heal that would waste more than maxOverheal of itself is skipped unless the target is in an emergency. group: a party heal gets a bonus once minHurt allies are under its threshold.

revive._doc: A fallen ally is worth the health they come back with times mult, plus their output for `rounds` rounds.

cleanse._doc: How many rounds of a unit's output each status on it costs per round it lasts. Damage over time is counted as its remaining damage.

focus._doc: killRounds: finishing a target is worth its output for this many rounds. lowHealth: extra weight on already-hurt targets. threat multiplies the value of hitting special targets; bossWithAdds lowers a boss while its adds still stand, so the adds go first. sleepingMult keeps attacks off something asleep while anything else is awake. thornsSelfHp: under this share of health a unit avoids hitting thorns.

aoe._doc: An area skill has to beat the best single-target option by minGain, and must actually reach minTargets living enemies, or it is not used.

taunt._doc: A unit with a taunt uses it when an ally that is not a tank (a healer, a caster, or anyone under squishyHp) was attacked within recentRounds rounds, as long as the taunter is above minSelfHp.

buffs._doc: horizon: rounds of a buff that count. earlyRounds/earlyMult: buffs are worth more in the opening rounds, before the fight turns. bigFightMult: worth more against a boss, champion or named enemy. nearlyWonRounds: when the party would finish every enemy within this many rounds of its own output, buffs are worth only nearlyWonMult. braceMult: shields and damage reduction are worth more while an enemy winds up a big spell. unknownValue: a buff key the scorer does not understand, as a share of the caster's own output.

statuses._doc: How much of a target's output a status takes away per round (a share). curse, weaken and marked read the status power instead. sleepWithDamage: a skill that deals damage wakes what it puts to sleep. bossCc: bosses shrug off half of all stuns, freezes and sleeps.

mana._doc: healerReserveCasts: a healer never spends below the cost of this many of its cheapest heal on anything that is not a heal. costWeight: a skill loses this share of its score per full mana bar it costs, more when mana is low. lowManaShare: under this share of mana, restoring mana is worth manaValue per point (as a share of output per 10 mana).

cooldown._doc: A skill with a cooldown of at least big rounds, or costing at least bigCostShare of the mana bar, is worth saveMult on an ordinary target with fewer than three enemies about.

enemy._doc: Enemies roll their spell chance as before; when the roll passes they pick the best spell and target instead of a random one, and skip spells worth nothing (a curse on someone already cursed, a heal with nobody hurt). healThreshold: enemy healers mend allies under this share. Basic attacks keep the original formation order (taunts, then companions, then the front of the party) unless focusAttacks is on. windUpMult: a spell that has to be channelled is worth this share of its value.
